promise.en: A go/no-go recommendation and an entry case your board can defend, in four to eight weeks.
promise.id: Rekomendasi lanjut/tidak dan kajian masuk yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan dewan Anda, dalam empat hingga delapan minggu.

metaDescription.en: Indonesia market assessment and entry strategy: demand, competitors, KBLI and ownership rules, entry modes, a three-year model, a board recommendation.
metaDescription.id: Penilaian pasar dan strategi masuk Indonesia: permintaan, pesaing, aturan KBLI dan kepemilikan, moda masuk, model tiga tahun, rekomendasi dewan.

who.en: Regional headquarters in Singapore, Europe, Japan or Korea with Indonesia on next year's plan
who.id: Kantor pusat regional di Singapura, Eropa, Jepang, atau Korea dengan Indonesia dalam rencana tahun depan

who.en: Fund operating partners taking a portfolio company into its next market
who.id: Operating partner dana investasi yang membawa perusahaan portofolio ke pasar berikutnya

who.en: Indonesian groups weighing a new segment or a foreign partner
who.id: Grup Indonesia yang menimbang segmen baru atau mitra asing

get.en: Demand sizing, competitor and price mapping, channel structure
get.id: Ukuran permintaan, pemetaan pesaing dan harga, struktur saluran

get.en: Regulatory map: KBLI, foreign-ownership limits, licence stack, incentives
get.id: Peta regulasi: KBLI, batas kepemilikan asing, susunan izin, insentif

get.en: Entry-mode options compared: distributor, joint venture, PT PMA, representative office
get.id: Perbandingan moda masuk: distributor, usaha patungan, PT PMA, kantor perwakilan

get.en: Three-year P&L, capital and incentive plan, risk register
get.id: Laba rugi tiga tahun, rencana modal dan insentif, daftar risiko

get.en: A board recommendation and a 90-day plan

getSummary.en: Market and regulatory map, entry-mode comparison, three-year model, board recommendation
getSummary.id: Peta pasar dan regulasi, perbandingan moda masuk, model tiga tahun, rekomendasi dewan

duration.en: Scoped to the engagement. Smaller pieces of work are typically complete within a week; larger engagements take longer, and we agree the timeline with you before we start.
duration.id: Disesuaikan dengan lingkup penugasan. Pekerjaan yang lebih kecil umumnya selesai dalam satu minggu; penugasan yang lebih besar membutuhkan waktu lebih lama, dan kami menyepakati jadwalnya bersama Anda sebelum mulai.

how.en: Weekly reviews with your sponsor; a mid-point read-out; the partner presents to your board.
how.id: Tinjauan mingguan dengan sponsor Anda; pemaparan tengah jalan; partner memaparkan kepada dewan Anda.

next.en: Most clients move to the partner and site search; the HQ approval deck is built with the Strategic Storytelling practice from the same numbers.
next.id: Sebagian besar klien melanjutkan ke pencarian mitra dan lokasi; dek persetujuan kantor pusat disusun bersama praktik Strategic Storytelling dari angka yang sama.

text.en: Decision framed; data requests; interviews scheduled.
text.id: Keputusan dirumuskan; permintaan data; wawancara dijadwalkan.

text.en: Market, competitor and regulatory evidence; 15–25 expert and channel interviews.
text.id: Bukti pasar, pesaing, dan regulasi; 15–25 wawancara pakar dan saluran.

text.en: Mid-point read-out: what we have found and what it implies.
text.id: Pemaparan tengah jalan: temuan dan implikasinya.

text.en: Entry modes, model, incentives, risks; draft recommendation.
text.id: Moda masuk, model, insentif, risiko; draf rekomendasi.

text.en: Board presentation by the partner; 90-day plan handed over.
text.id: Paparan dewan oleh partner; rencana 90 hari diserahkan.

text.en: Our market assessments use the same standard as our decks: the finding in the title, one map or chart that carries it, every figure labelled and sourced.
text.id: Penilaian pasar kami memakai standar yang sama dengan dek kami: temuan di judul, satu peta atau grafik yang membawanya, setiap angka berlabel dan bersumber.

caption.en: An illustrative investment-thesis page: the entry route in the title, the value chain mapped, each opportunity sized and sequenced.
caption.id: Halaman tesis investasi ilustratif: rute masuk di judul, rantai nilai dipetakan, setiap peluang diukur dan diurutkan.

alt.en: Investment-thesis page: "Enter through midstream, expand to upstream and power + regas opportunities post-PLN RUPTL", an isometric map of the Indonesian gas value chain with five sized opportunities from B2B piped gas to gas-to-power, and a short-, mid- and long-term pathway.
alt.id: Halaman tesis investasi: "Enter through midstream, expand to upstream and power + regas opportunities post-PLN RUPTL", peta isometrik rantai nilai gas Indonesia dengan lima peluang berukuran dari gas pipa B2B hingga gas-to-power, serta jalur jangka pendek, menengah, dan panjang.
